Secure Communications

Fax, Email and Messaging, Built to HIPAA Standards

Medical records still move by fax more often than most people expect, and email remains a routine part of coordinating with attorneys, adjusters and other providers. Both need to be secure, and both need to leave a record showing the message was actually delivered.

PMEX's secure communications layer handles fax, email and internal messaging through one HIPAA-compliant system, so every document exchange is protected and every message has a confirmed delivery trail.
